faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Government High School Hatibari Part Time Teacher (Sanskrit) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Part Time Teacher (Sanskrit) post is 06-10-2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Part Time Teacher (Sanskrit) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.A degree with Sanskrit or Sahityacharya to be eligible for the Part Time Teacher (Sanskrit) position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for applying to this recruitment?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit is 18 years and the maximum age limit is 35 years as of 01-09-2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Part Time Teacher (Sanskrit) post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 8250/-.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for this government job?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. You need to download the application form, fill it, and send it to the official address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the post of Part Time Teacher (Sanskrit).

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection will be based on merit determined by the marks obtained in the qualifying examination.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website jajpur.odisha.gov.in. Links are provided in the Important Links section.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job is on a contractual basis.
